note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row moved to {gap} under the owner ruling that RTR version 0 is owed. RFC 6810 Section 5.1 reads 'Zero:  Fields shown as zero or reserved MUST be zero.  The value of such a field MUST be ignored on receipt.' for the PDUs of protocol version 0 ('currently 0', Section 5). Ze never receives a version 0 PDU into its parsers: internal/component/bgp/plugins/rpki/rtr_session.go::RTRSession.handlePDU returns errRtrUnsupportedProtocol for every PDU but a Serial Notify or Error Report whose version is below rtrVersionMin = 1, refuses a cache's Error Report code 4 that offers a version below rtrVersionMin, and RTRSession.syncOnce never downgrades below rtrVersionMin. The reserved-field tolerance of parsePrefixPDU and handlePDU is real but is reached only in version 1 and 2 sessions and is proven under RFC8210-5-1 and RFC8210-5.1-1; the tests that once carried this id run version 1 and no longer tag it. No version 0 path exists, so the requirement is unmet.
